payout_quote: For the current customer (referrer) to receive the $50 Refer-A-Friend bonus: 1) Refer your friends to open a Sterling Eagle Checking Account with qualifying activities using this referral form.
steps: Be an eligible Sterling Bank & Trust personal account holder
Complete the referral form with your friend's information and have them submit it at account opening
Friend (new Sterling customer) opens a qualifying Eagle Checking Account with a $500 minimum opening balance
Friend's account remains open for 120 days
You receive the $50 Refer-A-Friend bonus approximately 120 days after account opening
catches: Referrer gets $50; the referred friend gets a much larger $250 bonus (requires 2 recurring $500 direct deposits within 120 days + online banking enrollment)
Referral form must be submitted at the time of account opening
Friend's account must remain open for 120 days; minimum $500 opening balance
Sterling Eagle Checking charges a $500 minimum balance to avoid fees
Referral form serves as a one-time waiver of privacy rights (each party may be aware the other is a customer)
biggest_catch: You get $50 — but only ~120 days after your friend opens, and the paperwork has to be filed at account opening. Your friend, meanwhile, gets $250.
eligibility: Eligible Sterling Bank & Trust personal account holders; referred friends must be new customers
timing: Referral bonus available approximately 120 days after account opening
